source_title: Jujutsu Kaisen Officially Confirms New Story For Nobara
source_excerpt:
Gege Akutami’s Jujutsu Kaisen manga ended way too early for a story of such grandeur. What's more, the world of Jujutsu Kaisen still had a lot of unexplored lore, which fans would've loved to see tackled. Luckily for us fans of the franchise, Gege Akutami, the original creator of Jujutsu Kaisen, returned in late 2025 with a short sequel, known as Jujutsu Kaisen: Modulo.
Modulo is set 68 years after the Sukuna battle. As such, by the time of the sequel, most of the original cast has already passed away. We do, however, see the return of a few characters greatly aged up. While Yuji remains relatively young, thanks to his status as a slow-aging Death Painting, the same can’t be said about his old friend Nobara. Nobara Kugisaki still lives on in Jujutsu Kaisen: Modulo as an old woman. Thanks to her brief return, we finally got a closer look at her new life. In this new sequel, we discover that Nobara remains single and is living in luxury in Kyoto. Nobara's story, sadly, will end with Modulo, and she will be one more friend that Yuji will have to see die very soon.
Nobara’s Original Story In Jujutsu Kaisen
Nobara was one of the main characters who was introduced quite early on in Gege Akutami's Jujutsu Kaisen . She specifically made her first appearance in Jujutsu Kaisen chapter 3, which was released on March 19, 2018, in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump Issue #16. Upon her introduction, she became an integral part of JJK’s early arcs, and we quickly got to learn more about her story and how she got here in the first place. Nobara was raised in a small town in Japan. However, she hated that life and how people treated her for being different. Wanting to experience freedom and flexibility by herself in a big city like Tokyo, she finally decided to move.
Thankfully, she was able to leave her small town with the guidance and help of her grandmother, who turned her into the Sorcerer that she is today. Upon moving to Tokyo and integrating into Jujutsu High, Nobara's powers and abilities would grow alongside her. However, her story came to an abrupt end for a while. During the Shibuya arc, Nobara was almost killed by Mahito and put into a coma .
Gege Akutami, the creator of the series, teased the idea of her death, but she eventually made a return near the conclusion of the Sukuna battle to assist Yuji . In this fight, she helped take down the King of Curses once and for all, but by that time, she had already missed out on being a part of much of the story.
Nevertheless, with her return, Nobara only lost one eye, and we got to see more of her story in the Jujutsu Kaisen one-shot from December 2024. To fulfill Gojo Satoru’s final wish for her, Nobara obliged and decided to go meet up with her mother. While her mother remained as uncaring as ever, Nobara and her grandmother finally confronted her for her behavior, and we saw a great conclusion to her character arc. Our main heroine now makes a bigger return after 68 years, during the events of Jujutsu Kaisen: Modulo.
Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo Gives Nobara A New Ending In Luxury In Kyoto
Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo is a sequel to the Jujutsu Kaisen series. It began serialization between September 8, 2025, and March 9, 2026, with a collaboration between Gege Akutami, the original creator of the Jujutsu Kaisen series, and Yuji Iwasaki, a talented artist who undertook the illustration of this manga. With this new sequel, we've come to discover that many of our beloved and lovable original cast have already died. This includes the likes of Megumi , who passed away under unknown circumstances, as well as others like Hana, Maki, and Yuta Okkotsu. While much of our main cast is dead, Nobara is still alive and well.
In Modulo, Nobara is around 84 years old, and we get to see her fulfilled life after years of being a Jujutsu Sorcerer . Her first official appearance in the Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo manga was in Chapter 13. In this chapter, she is asked about the whereabouts of Yuji Itadori, who, at this point, had been missing for years. Nobara made another return at the end of Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo, in chapter 25, where Yuji finally decides to go and meet his old friend once more.
Through this final chapter, we discover Nobara's satisfying and comfortable life after she made it big. She was able to realize her dream and forever move on to a big city, leaving behind her village life. In fact, it's been confirmed that Nobara actually lives in a luxury building in Kyoto in her old age, meaning she received quite a lot of compensation through her work as a Sorcerer. It’s also implied that Nobara remained single all these years, with nothing implying she ever got married, just like Yuji. Even though Nobara was sidelined in the original series, we were also excited to see her return for a brief while, and to see how her life has turned out after the many hardships she has gone through.

Nobara’s Story Will End in Modulo, With Yuji Losing One More Friend
Nobara's return in Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo was brief but still captivating and one that was very well received by fans of the series who still deeply care about her character. While she does appear 68 years into the future, she is now extremely old, and likely she doesn't have much left to live. Despite that, she has a huge role to play in the story of Modulo. As things stand, Nobara Kugisaki has joined hands with Yuji Itadori to find all the Heavenly Restriction users and then train them. She is also going to help Yuji mass-produce the Cursed Tools in the Gojo Clan inventory, and finally, help him learn how to become a Cursed Object.
Still, at the end of it all, Nobara is likely not to be included in the plot anymore due to her short remaining lifespan. Nobara’s death will definitely be a hard one for Yuji Itadori to swallow, especially after he has already lost Megumi Fushiguro in the past, alongside others of his close friends like Maki and Yuta. Even Aoi Todo, who is currently alive and well, will likely not live long. Yuji will remain as the sole survivor from the original Jujutsu Kaisen series.
We do know that a future sequel after Modulo is possible due to the setup from Gege Akutami in Modulo Chapter 25. In the Modulo Volume #3 author comments, Gege revealed that Yuji ages slower, as someone who has consumed the Death Paintings. But since he isn’t fully immortal, he will eventually die. His death is estimated to happen 300 years into the future , setting up a possible return of the story then. Yuji has the potential to return even after death, as he will eventually turn into a Cursed Object that can be consumed, just like Sukuna, but for Nobara, this is the end of the road.
Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo by Gege Akutami is available to read via Manga Plus and Viz Media .
